     1 | # jobrunner
     2 | 
     3 | Small job runner with a configurable bounded retry policy.
     4 | 
     5 | ## Retry policy
     6 | 
     7 | `run_job` preserves its public signature and accepts a `RetryConfig`, an
     8 | injected `Sleeper`, and a job closure. `max_attempts` is the total number of
     9 | calls, including the first call. Transient errors are retried with delays of
    10 | `base_delay_ms`, then twice that delay, and so on, capped at `max_delay_ms`.
    11 | Permanent errors are returned immediately, without sleeping. A zero
    12 | `max_attempts` value is treated as one attempt.
    13 | 
    14 | ```rust
    15 | use jobrunner::{run_job, FakeSleeper, RetryConfig, RetryError};
    16 | 
    17 | let config = RetryConfig::new(3, 100, 500);
    18 | let mut sleeper = FakeSleeper::default();
    19 | let result = run_job(&config, &mut sleeper, || {
    20 |     Err(RetryError::Transient("temporary outage".into()))
    21 | });
    22 | assert!(result.is_err());
    23 | assert_eq!(sleeper.sleeps, vec![100, 200]);
    24 | ```
